earnings.explanation: Anthropic, PBC is a public benefit corporation incorporated under Delaware law, focused on the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity. The developer of the Claude AI model filed its S-1 registration statement on October 26, 2026, for a proposed Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT. Revenue grew from $41M (2023) to $386M (2024) to $4.6B (2025), then reached $16.3B in the six months ended June 30, 2026. Q3 2026 revenue was $16.8B per investor-day disclosure. The H1 2026 net loss of $80.7B is driven almost entirely by a $72.4B change in the fair value of convertible notes and derivative liabilities as the enterprise valuation rose; operating cash flow was positive at $3.93B. As of September 30, more than 1,900 customers generated at least $1M in annualized revenue. The company held $131.7B in cash and short-term investments as of June 30, 2026. The IPO price range and share count have not yet been determined.
earnings.companyDescription: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company developing frontier AI models, including the Claude family of assistants. It operates as a public benefit corporation with a Long-Term Benefit Trust and a special Class T common stock that gives AI-safety-focused trustees majority board representation.

The developer of the Claude AI model filed its S-1 registration statement on October 26, 2026, for a proposed Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT, with an amended S-1/A filed November 2, 2026 adding Q3 2026 financials. Revenue grew from $41M (2023) to $386M (2024) to $4.6B (2025). Nine-month 2026 revenue reached $33.24B: Q1 $4.73B, Q2 $11.56B, Q3 $16.96B. Q3 operating loss was $567M (adjusted operating income $2.5B), driven by $5B in short-term compute commitments. Net loss was $23.29B in Q3, mostly from a $21.9B fair value adjustment on convertible notes. The company held $131.7B in cash as of June 30, 2026, and has $895.4B in aggregate committed compute and infrastructure spend. As of September 30, more than 11,900 customers generated at least $100K in ARR. The IPO price range and share count have not yet been determined.

earnings.explanation: BYD Electronic (International) Company Limited (HKEX: 0285, OTC: BYDIF) is a Shenzhen-based electronics manufacturer and a subsidiary within the BYD group. It provides design, manufacturing, assembly, and components for smartphones, computers, AI computing infrastructure, smart home and automotive electronics, and other smart products. For the year ended 31 December 2025, revenue was RMB 179.48 billion (+1.22% YoY) and profit attributable to owners was RMB 3.51 billion (-17.61% YoY), with basic EPS of RMB 1.56; the board proposed a final dividend of RMB 0.156 per share. Management attributed the profit decline mainly to a product sales mix shift toward lower-gross-margin products. Key valuation, balance-sheet, and cash-flow figures below are from Yahoo Finance key statistics (CNY context, mrq 2025-12-31) and should be cross-checked against live filings.
earnings.companyDescription: BYD Electronic (International) Company Limited designs and manufactures mobile handset components and modules, and provides assembly and one-stop product solutions across smartphones, computers, new energy vehicle electronics, AI server/computing infrastructure, smart home, game hardware, and IoT products. It is listed in Hong Kong (0285.HK) and trades OTC in the U.S. as BYDIF.
